title: Settings and accessibility - House of Pips Wiki
description: Every House of Pips settings tab: language, display, sound, animation, accessibility options such as colorblind mode, high contrast and large text, and voice chat.
html:
Settings and accessibility

Open Settings from the main menu or from the menu button during a match. Changes save automatically. Settings has four tabs: General, Animation, Accessibility and Voice chat.

General #

  • Language: Auto (follows your Steam language), English, 简体中文, Русский, Español (España), Português (Brasil), Italiano, Español (Latinoamérica) or 日本語.
  • Display mode: Fullscreen or Windowed.
  • Sound effects and Music volume.
  • Music order: play your selected song or shuffle, plus a Next song button.
  • Anonymous error reports: choose whether the game may send bug reports. The first-launch prompt explains what is included and what is excluded. You can change your answer here at any time.

Animation #

  • Draft reveal how perk cards are revealed (Pixel scan, Conjurer's Seal, Bone Cascade, Jackpot Vault or Minimal).
  • Score popups Pixel outline (the default) or Soft shadow lettering for score calls. Your saved choice is kept across updates.
  • Animation speed Cinematic, Quick or Instant.
  • Avatar microphone uses your microphone to animate your portrait outside voice chat. Off by default, and the audio is never saved.

Accessibility #

  • Menu narration reads the hovered or focused menu control aloud with the Windows voice. Press F1 to switch it on or off anywhere.
  • Colorblind mode swaps to a blue and orange accent palette.
  • High contrast a plain dark background, opaque panels and brighter text and controls.
  • Text size Standard or Large.
  • Reduce motion calms screen movement and locks the draft reveal to Minimal.
  • Drag targets Standard or Large drop zones for placing bones.
  • Controller bindings Edit in Steam opens your Steam Input layout.

Every rarity also has its own frame shape, shown in a legend on this tab, so you never need colour alone to tell a Rare card from an Epic one.

Voice chat #

  • Chat volume for online voice chat.
  • Whether your microphone starts live or muted, and whether your opponent's voice starts heard or muted, at the start of each match.
  • Silence muted voices.
  • Voice style: Natural, Table radio, House phone, Gramophone or Arcade cabinet. Use Sample and Hear my mic to try them.
  • Speaker and Microphone device pickers.

During a match #

Settings opened from the table also offers Save and exit and Rage quit. See Saving, Continue and Steam Cloud.
